stvoyHM.exe.IN_JoyMove: 0x43f3a0; joy_xbutton read 0x43f66f (X), joy_ybutton 0x43f6d1 (Y); when 0, Sys_QueEvent(SE_JOYSTICK_AXIS, axis 0/1, ftol(-v*127)) at 0x43f6a0/0x43f715, 0 inside joy_threshold; when 1, Quake III direction bits; Z and R always direction bits
stvoyHM.exe.CL_JoystickMove: 0x409f10; yaw += cl_yawspeed * 0.01 (0x4b7430) * axis[AXIS_SIDE] * anglespeed unless +strafe; pitch likewise with +mlook; otherwise rightmove/forwardmove += axis

stvoy.exe.IN_JoyMove: joy_xbutton read 0x42da67, joy_ybutton 0x42dad5; axis events at 0x42dac3 and 0x42db40; same rule as Holomatch
